title: The Dragon Fighting Formation
summary: Wang Lin reaches the headquarters of the Fighting Evil Sect with Li Muwan, Shangguan Mo, Mu Nan and Mu Bei, and Li Muwan admits to herself that she once mistook him for Sun Youcai. The sect leader, Jie Donglai, meets him with the Dragon Fighting Formation, powered by 13,562 disciples and said to be unbreakable by anyone below Nascent Soul. Drawing on the formation, Jie Donglai rises from late Core Formation to great perfection and then to the False Nascent Soul realm, which is between Core Formation and true Nascent Soul. He brushes off the death spell, since the formation pours ten thousand people's power into him. Wang Lin, fighting at Core Formation, is wounded, and Jie Donglai turns on Li Muwan. Xu Liguo urges a retreat, but Wang Lin refuses. In the end Li Muwan works out how to break the formation.
